User Story: As a policyholder, I want to start a claim using my policy so that I can report an incident online.
As a policyholder, I want to enter the incident date, type, and description so that the insurer receives the basic claim facts.
As a policyholder, I want the portal to validate my policy and required claim fields so that I can correct errors before submission.
As a policyholder, I want to submit a valid claim and receive a reference number so that I can identify my claim later.
As a policyholder, I want to see which documents are required for my claim type so that I can prepare the correct evidence.
As a policyholder, I want to upload a supported document so that the claims team can review evidence.
As a policyholder, I want clear feedback when a file type or size is not accepted so that I can upload a valid document.
As a policyholder, I want to see the documents attached to my claim so that I can confirm what I provided.
As a policyholder, I want to see the current status of my claim so that I understand where it is in the process.
As a policyholder, I want to view dated claim updates so that I can understand important changes to my claim.
As a policyholder, I want to respond to a request for more information so that claim assessment can continue.
As a policyholder, I want to choose email or SMS claim updates so that I receive information through my preferred channel.
As a policyholder, I want to be notified when a settlement decision is available so that I know the outcome of my claim.
